rich_narrative.summary:
Founded in 2002, Al-Maghrib Institute provides Islamic educational programming through <cite id="4">in-person seminars and online courses</cite>. Operating across the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Spain, and Japan, the institute aims to deliver accessible learning experiences [4]. In FY2024, the organization managed <cite id="3">$3,845,691 in total revenue</cite> [3]. Financial filings from FY2023 show a total expense profile of $2,697,890 against $2,959,388 in total revenue, down from $3,216,305 in FY2022 [3].

The organization maintains high spending on direct services, directing a <cite id="3">program expense ratio of 95.0%</cite> toward its core educational initiatives [3]. It maintains <cite id="3">$5,604,790 in total assets</cite> against <cite id="3">$175,285 in liabilities</cite>, resulting in substantial operating reserves [3]. The institute accepts Zakat funds designated for <cite id="2">fi sabilillah purposes</cite> to support its student programs [2]. At the same time, executive compensation presents a notable consideration, with <cite id="3">officer compensation of $216,728</cite> representing over 5% of annual revenue [3].
